info.name: VaachakAI Local Endpoint Tests
info.description: Ordered workflow covering all current API operations, including intentional history-deletion guards and invalid reset-token behavior. Creates synthetic users/content; deletes the synthetic learner and its attempts. Teacher and authored content remain. Run only against an isolated test server. Silence WAV verifies upload/download, not speech recognition. AI 503 is expected without a provider key; this does not validate live AI generation. Run against the local development server only.

exec: pm.test(configured ? "AI returns generated items" : "AI correctly reports missing configuration (503)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(configured ? 200 : 503));
